title: Link Alley
summary: Max runs through Link Alley, learning to check a link, a sender or a pop-up before tapping.

levels.title: Read the address
levels.goal: Max needs to get to the real Library.
levels.rule: Read the address. Every letter counts.

grownUpChallenge.prompt: Which web address is the real Library?
grownUpChallenge.explain: libary.org is missing an r, and the last one hides the real name in front of a different ending.

options.label: libary.org
options.redFlag: libary.org is missing an r. Fakes copy real names and change one letter.

options.label: FREE-GAMES-library.win
options.redFlag: The real name is buried in a long address that ends in .win.

options.label: brigthmart.example
options.redFlag: The letters in brightmart are swapped around.

options.label: northfield-school.login.win
options.redFlag: The real name comes first, but the address really ends in login-now.win.

options.label: northfie1d-school.example
options.redFlag: A number 1 is pretending to be a letter l.

rounds.prompt: Max wants the Moonbeam Games page.

options.label: moonbeam-garnes.example
options.redFlag: An r and an n squeezed together look like an m.

rounds.prompt: Max needs the QuickShip Parcel tracker.

options.label: quickship-track.win
options.redFlag: The address ends in .win, not the real quickship.example.

options.label: quick-shlp.example/track
options.redFlag: The word quickship is spelled wrong.

rounds.prompt: Max is looking for the town pool.

options.label: townp00l.example
options.redFlag: Zeros are pretending to be the letter o.

levels.title: Who sent it?
levels.goal: Max must sort messages before reaching the exit.
levels.rule: Pause and ask: do I know who really sent this?

grownUpChallenge.prompt: A text says "Your parcel is stuck, tap here to pay a fee." You were not expecting a parcel. What is the safest move?
options: Ignore it, then check with the shop directly
grownUpChallenge.explain: Scam texts use surprise problems and links. Check using an app or number you already trust.

rounds.prompt: A message pops up. Trust it or report it?

item.text: Grandma Rosa: Dinner at 6! Bring your appetite.

rounds.whySafe: It is from someone you know and talks about a normal plan.

rounds.prompt: A message pops up. Trust it or report it?

item.text: QuickShip: Your parcel is stuck. Pay a fee at once!

rounds.redFlag: A surprise problem with a rush to pay is a classic trick.

rounds.prompt: A link arrives. Trust it or report it?
rounds.redFlag: The address ends in .win and promises a gift you never asked for.

rounds.prompt: A link arrives from your teacher. Trust it or report it?
rounds.whySafe: It is the real school address, and your teacher shared it in class.

rounds.prompt: A message pops up. Trust it or report it?

item.text: Your account is LOCKED. Tap here to unlock it now.

rounds.redFlag: Scary threats and "now" try to make you tap before you think.

rounds.prompt: A message pops up. Trust it or report it?

item.text: Coach Sam: Practice moved to 4pm on Friday.

rounds.whySafe: It is from a person you know about something you expected.

levels.title: Prizes and pop-ups
levels.goal: Max must spot the tricks hiding in the bright lights.
levels.habit: If it sounds too good, stop.
levels.rule: Free prizes and loud pop-ups are a reason to stop and ask.

grownUpChallenge.prompt: A pop-up says "You won a free phone! Tap to claim." What gives it away as fake?
options: It is a surprise prize you never entered for
grownUpChallenge.explain: Real prizes do not appear from nowhere. A surprise prize with a button to tap is bait.

rounds.prompt: A pop-up appears. Trust it or report it?

item.text: YOU WON a free phone! Tap to claim in 60 seconds!

rounds.redFlag: A surprise prize plus a countdown is bait to rush you.

rounds.prompt: A pop-up appears. Trust it or report it?

item.text: Your game finished updating. Tap OK to keep playing.

rounds.whySafe: It is a normal message from the game you chose to open.

rounds.prompt: Max wants to download the Moonbeam Games app.

options.label: free-moonbeam-app.win
options.redFlag: A free-app site ending in .win is not the real store.

options.label: moonbeam-games-prize.example
options.redFlag: Real stores do not put prize in the address.

rounds.prompt: Max wants the Library eBook page.

options.label: library-ebooks-free.win
options.redFlag: The real name is mixed into a long address ending in .win.

rounds.prompt: A poster has a square code. Trust it or report it?

item.text: Sticker on a lamp post: Scan for free pizza!

rounds.redFlag: A sticker stuck over something else can hide a code that opens a fake site.

rounds.prompt: Your teacher shows a square code on screen. Trust it or report it?

item.text: Class screen: Scan to join our reading club page.

rounds.whySafe: You can see who is sharing it and why, and it matches what you were told.

boss.name: PHISH.BOT
boss.intro: I am PHISH.BOT! Every message I send is totally real. Totally.

messages.text: Your account is LOCKED! Tap here
messages.redFlag: Scary threat and a link to tap.

messages.text: You won a free phone! Claim now
messages.redFlag: A surprise prize you never entered for.

messages.text: QuickShip: Pay a fee or lose your parcel
messages.redFlag: A surprise problem and a rush to pay.

messages.text: Class chat: Homework is on page 12
